newsitem.title: USA: US antitrust authorities release merger guidelines.
newsitem.headline: US antitrust authorities release merger guidelines.

text.p: The Justice Department and the Federal Trade Commission on Tuesday released long-awaited new guidelines on efficiencies in mergers.

The government said the guidelines, released on the eve of the American Bar Association's spring meeting of its antitrust section in Washington, make it clear what merging firms must do to demonstrate claimed efficiencies.

The guidelines show that one question government regulators will ask is whether efficiencies enhance a merged firm's capacity to behave competitively, leading to higher quality, better service, lower prices or new products.
